item.title: USA Rugby to introduce 'open' gender category for trans athletes
item.description: USA Rugby announced a new open gender division for trans athletes in response to President Donald Trump's executive order requiring men to stay out of women's sports.

item.title: Dem Washington House majority leader apologizes for being ‘impaired’ during budget hearing
item.description: Washington state Democratic lawmaker Joe Fitzgibbon apologized after drinking alcohol before a House committee hearing where he appeared with slurred speech.

item.description: Discover this weekend’s best Amazon deals, including spring cleaning essentials, tech upgrades, kitchen must-haves, style staples and beauty favorites — all at limited-time discounts.

item.title: Trump floats Ted Cruz for Supreme Court, jokes he’d get ‘100%’ bipartisan vote to ‘get him out of there’
item.description: President Donald Trump joked about putting Sen. Ted Cruz on the Supreme Court, saying he'd get "100% of votes" because lawmakers want to "get him out" of Congress.

item.title: ICE blasts Washington mayor over directive restricting immigration enforcement
item.description: Everett Mayor Cassie Franklin issued a directive limiting ICE immigration enforcement in city buildings, sparking federal backlash over escalating tensions.

item.title: Biden accuses Trump of erasing history and squandering US leadership role on global stage: 'Dark days'
item.description: Former President Biden accused President Trump of trying to erase truth and history, claiming he threatens democracy and America's global leadership role.

item.title: Top NFL prospect Fernando Mendoza says team suggested he get arrested to fall in the draft
item.description: Fernando Mendoza reveals a team executive suggested he get arrested to slide in the NFL draft, despite being projected as the No. 1 overall pick to the Las Vegas Raiders.

item.title: Israel launches preemptive strike against Iran, defense minister says
item.description: Israel launched a preemptive strike against Iran early Saturday, according to an announcement from Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz.
